tabId.description: Tab ID(s) from tab_list, tab_open, or a bound computer_use handle.

profileId.description: Profile ID from browser_profile_list; the profile's home selects its computer.

computerId.description: Computer ID from computer_list; for Guest, omitted means the hosting computer.

windowId.description: Opaque exact-window handle from computer_use app.windows() or the Host window picker; valid on this computer only.

bundleId.description: Installed approved app bundle ID from computer_use apps(); binds one window after opening the app.

appId.description: App ID from app_list or app_publish.

beforeTabId.description: Tab ID from tab_list. Inside a group, inserts before that member. At root, a group’s first member anchors its top-level boundary. Whole-group moves use an outside anchor; omit it to append the block. Empty groups cannot be anchors.
